# 🔐 Privacy Request Intake

## Request metadata
- Received date:
- Request reference:
- Request type: access / correction / deletion / restriction / other
- Verification status:
- Assigned owner:

## Scope
Record the minimum information required to locate the relevant account. Keep identity documents and sensitive data in approved secure systems, not GitHub issues.

## Processing
- [ ] Identity verified using approved process.
- [ ] Scope clarified.
- [ ] Legal/retention constraints reviewed.
- [ ] Data sources identified.
- [ ] Action approved and completed.
- [ ] Response sent through approved channel.

## Audit
Record timestamps, responsible roles and outcome without copying personal data into repository history.
